request.query: How has the number of trials for Pembrolizumab changed per year since 2015?

visualization.title: Trials started per year for Pembrolizumab
visualization.subtitle: 2909 trials analyzed; start 2015 to present. Source: ClinicalTrials.gov

interpretation.rationale: A time trend analysis showing trials per start year will reveal how Pembrolizumab trial activity has changed annually since 2015.

assumptions: Year = study start date (actual or anticipated) from statusModule.startDateStruct.
warnings: 2026 is a partial year; later years also include trials with anticipated start dates.
